newsitem.title: UK: BP cuts crude runs at Nerefco complex-trade.
newsitem.headline: BP cuts crude runs at Nerefco complex-trade.

text.p: British Petroleum Plc (BP) has cut crude throughput at the Rotterdam refinery it shares with Texaco because of poor product margins, oil industry sources said on Thursday.
BP owns 65 percent of the 400,000 barrel per day (bpd) Nerefco refinery complex. Traders said BP had cut crude runs by about 12 percent, equivalent to around 30,000 bpd.
A BP spokesman could not confirm the reduction but said profit margins on refined products were being squeezed.
"In the light of very poor margins, BP is constantlny reviewing its refinery crude runs and fine tuning accordingly," he said.
Earlier, Texaco Netherlands said sustained pressure on margins had forced it to increase crude run cuts at Nerefco to 12.5 percent, equivalent to a cut of 17,500 bpd.
Texaco Inc, which owns 35 percent of the complex, said on Tuesday it had cut runs by 10 percent.
